problem_keywords: mould behind plasterboard on block walls
use_cases: lining internal concrete tilt-up or precast panels behind furring channels and plasterboard
retrofitting basement or core-filled block walls to prevent interstitial condensation
providing a thin-profile thermal and vapour-permeable barrier in masonry cavity retrofits
not_for: external direct weather-exposed cladding without rainscreen
retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Permiwall is a discontinued 5.5mm thermo-reflective insulation and vapour-permeable membrane engineered specifically for internal concrete and masonry block walls. Comprising a micro-perforated closed-cell foam core between reflective foil facings, it allowed moisture vapour to permeate rather than condense against cold masonry, while reflecting radiant heat into the living space. Installed over furring channels or clips beneath plasterboard, it provided an ultra-slim thermal solution that helped achieve 6-star residential energy ratings without sacrificing floor area.
